name: Grand Austria Hotel

categories.label: Victory points on the track
categories.help: Your marker on the Victory Point track before final scoring, including any 75-point marker and Emperor scoring from earlier rounds.

categories.label: Staff end-game points
categories.help: Points from your played Staff cards that score at game end.

categories.label: Occupied rooms, row 1
categories.help: Occupied rooms in the bottom row of your hotel; 1 point each.

categories.label: Occupied rooms, row 2
categories.help: Occupied rooms in the second row; 2 points each.

categories.label: Occupied rooms, row 3
categories.help: Occupied rooms in the third row; 3 points each.

categories.label: Occupied rooms, row 4
categories.help: Occupied rooms in the top row; 4 points each.

categories.label: Leftover krones, dishes and drinks
categories.help: Krones plus dishes and drinks still in your kitchen, 1 point each; the most wins a tie.

categories.label: Guests left in the cafe
categories.help: Guests still waiting in your cafe; each costs you 5 points.

notes: Base game only. Read from the publisher (Lookout) PDF. 2-4 players taken from the setup text (dice for 2, 3 and 4 players). Expansions and variants excluded. The tie-break counts krones, dishes and drinks together, as the rulebook phrases it.
